items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mongo Santamaria on bongos, Bebo Alan on bass, Modesto Perez on the claves, Miguel Luís on maracas, and Raul Diaz who was the director on the guitar.

ctx.x: Let’s return to the Apolo Septet. Apart from Mongo, who else was part of the group?

Well, starting with Mongo on bongos, Bebo Alan on bass, Miguel Luis, no Jose Luis on claves - sorry, Modesto Perez on claves, later he was the singer in the Hermanos Contreras Orchestra. Let's put them in order again. Mongo Santamaria on bongos, Bebo Alan on bass, Modesto Perez on the claves, Miguel Luís on maracas, and Raul Diaz who was the director on the guitar. And the other, the other trumpet was, Miguelito, Miguelito, Miguelito, I am trying to remember the name now, Miguelito, well now I do not remember the…
Now maestro, what year are we talking about more or less?
